protocol.title: Characterizing Deformability and Electrical Properties of Breast Cancer Cells Using a Microfluidic Device Combining Electrical Impedance Sensing and Mechanical Constriction
protocol.platform: Pressure-driven PDMS microfluidic device with integrated coplanar gold electrodes (differential impedance configuration)
cell_lines: modMCF-7 (MCF-7 treated with 500 nM PMA for 18 h, increased deformability)
fixedMCF-7 (MCF-7 fixed with 4% methanol-free formaldehyde, stiffened)
RBC (human red blood cells, highly deformable reference)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous characterisation of single-cell mechanical deformability (passage time, entry time, transit time) and electrical properties (impedance of undeformed and deformed cells) as cells are driven through an 8 um wide constriction under applied pressure

fabrication.bonding: oxygen plasma treatment; PDMS-glass alignment with XY positioner; bake 120 C 1 h

electrodes.configuration: coplanar, patterned on bottom glass substrate
electrodes.design: differential; outer pairs sense undeformed cells, inner pairs sense fully deformed cells

advantage_over_nondifferential: Measures both undeformed and deformed cell impedance in same transit event
Automatically rejects multi-cell transit events via sign-reversal peak check
Insensitive to environmental drift in channel
Not limited to short straight constrictions for signal detectability

pma_reagent.name: Phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA)
pma_reagent.effect: Activates PKC; remodels cortical actin; increases cell deformability

modMCF7.preparation: treat with 500 nM PMA 18 h at 37 C, then resuspend in PBS

fixedMCF7.preparation: fix in 4% methanol-free formaldehyde 8 min; quench with 0.127 M glycine 5 min; resuspend in PBS

cell_preparation.size_note: All three MCF-7 populations show similar size distributions (avg 22-23 um); size is not a confounding variable in deformability comparison

steps.name: PMA modification of MCF-7 cells (modMCF-7 preparation)
steps.notes: PMA activates protein kinase C, inducing cortical actin remodelling and increasing deformability. Treated at 500 nM (dose-response also tested at 100 nM and 300 nM; see Figure S6).

steps.name: Formaldehyde fixation of MCF-7 cells (fixedMCF-7 preparation)
steps.notes: Methanol-free formaldehyde preserves membrane integrity while crosslinking cytoskeleton. Glycine quenches unreacted aldehyde groups.

steps.name: Channel priming with 1% BSA in PBS
steps.purpose: Blocks hydrophobic PDMS surfaces to prevent non-specific cell adhesion to channel walls
steps.notes: Positive pressure applied at inlet via Fluigent MFCS-EZ to flow priming solution through channel.

steps.name: Untreated MCF-7 cell measurement (500 mbar)
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection
steps.flow_abstraction: mix abstracted as pressure-driven channel loading event (not DMF merge)

measured_parameters.Z_undeformed: impedance of cell in suspension before entering constriction (outer electrode pairs); reflects cell size and membrane capacitance
measured_parameters.Z_deformed: impedance of cell fully deformed inside constriction (inner electrode pairs); dominated by cell membrane electrical properties

pass.note: Valid bipolar peak pair detected: single-cell confirmed by differential sign-reversal

fail.note: Invalid event: multi-cell transit or no cell; successive same-sign peaks flag multi-cell

steps.name: PMA-modified MCF-7 cell measurement (500 mbar)
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection
steps.expected_result: Shorter passage/entry/transit times vs untreated MCF-7; lower impedance of undeformed cell reflecting increased deformability

steps.name: Formaldehyde-fixed MCF-7 cell measurement (500 mbar and 200 mbar)
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection
steps.statistical_test: Mann-Whitney; *** p < 0.001 for all pairwise comparisons
steps.expected_result: Longest passage/entry/transit times of all populations; maximum stiffness from cytoskeletal crosslinking

steps.name: RBC reference measurement (200 mbar and 500 mbar) with optical validation
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow through constriction + differential impedance detection + optical passage-time validation
steps.optical_instrument: Phantom v9.1 high-speed camera (Vision Research), 1000 fps
steps.expected_result: Shortest passage/entry/transit times (RBC ~8 um diameter, highly deformable biconcave disc); optical and impedance timing measurements cross-validated

pass.note: Valid RBC transit confirmed by both impedance peak and optical frame analysis

pma_dose_response.description: Figure S6: MCF-7 treated with 100 nM, 300 nM, 500 nM PMA vs untreated control
pma_dose_response.conclusion: 500 nM selected as optimal concentration for maximum deformability increase with consistent impedance shift

multi_cell_rejection.rule: Single-cell transit: one positive peak followed by one negative peak (or vice versa). Multiple cells: successive same-sign peaks.
multi_cell_rejection.advantage: Conventional non-differential 2-electrode measurement cannot distinguish multi-cell events; falsely records as single large cell
